coverage.not_covered: Every other district or state, the summer (zaid) season, perennial crops, and multi-season crops.

status: SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DATA. Not for real planting decisions.

assumption_codes.A1: Authored prototype assumption. A plausible-looking synthetic value chosen for demonstration. Not measured, not taken from a market series, and not reviewed by an agronomist.
assumption_codes.A2: Reported by an earlier prototype from a named public page. That page was not reachable from this build environment, so the value is unverified and treated as an assumption.

fields.sow_start / sow_end: MM-DD sowing window (A1). The plan sows on sow_start of the chosen season year.
fields.duration_days: Days from sowing to start of harvest (A1).
fields.harvest_days: Length of harvest window in days; revenue is spread evenly over it (A1).
fields.irrigation_mm: Seasonal irrigation depth needed beyond rainfall, in mm (A1). 0 means grown on rainfall or residual moisture.
fields.crop_water_mm: Total seasonal crop water use (rain + irrigation), in mm (A1). Used only by the digital twin's weekly water view.
fields.labor_days_per_acre: Person-days of work per acre over the season (A1). Used only by the digital twin's weekly labour view.
fields.yield_q_per_acre: Expected yield in quintals per acre in a normal season (A1).
fields.price_rs_per_q: Assumed farm-gate price in INR per quintal (A1). NOT an observed market price.
fields.cost_rs_per_acre: Assumed direct cash cost per acre: seed, fertilizer, plant protection, hired labour (A1). Excludes family labour, land rent and interest.
fields.yield_cv / price_cv: Coefficient of variation used by the simulation (A1).
fields.drought_sensitivity: Share of a weather-state severity that reduces this crop's yield (A1).
fields.failure_prob: Per-season chance of near-total crop loss from pests, disease or other causes (A1).
fields.min_share / max_share: Allowed fraction of the plot if the crop is selected (A1).

sources_note: No external source was consulted and verified for this version. The water-level mapping (rainfed 0 mm, limited 75 mm, assured 300 mm) is also A1.
